title: Insider Threat - Anomalous Data Staging by Departing Employee
root_cause: Departing employee exfiltrated confidential client data ahead of resignation.

timeline.description: Bulk access to confidential client contract repository outside normal duties
Approximately 4.2 GB of files copied to a local staging folder
Staged files uploaded to a personal cloud storage account

recommended_action: Block outbound data transfer channels and initiate a data loss review.
executive_summary: Anomalous activity consistent with insider threat behavior was observed involving employee account tlee and endpoint TLEE-LAPTOP, progressing through Collection -> Exfiltration. Immediate action is recommended to stop further data loss.
